environment.description: Deployed on EKS 1.28 with Pod Security Admission (PSA) enforcing 'restricted' profile at namespace level. Container securityContext specifies runAsNonRoot: true, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false. The pod spec includes securityContext.seccompProfile.type: RuntimeDefault. Additionally, a Cilium L4 NetworkPolicy restricts pod egress to only port 5432 (PostgreSQL) on a specific ClusterIP service CIDR. The node's container runtime (containerd 1.7.x) applies a custom AppArmor profile 'k8s-analytics-restricted' that denies network_raw and mount capabilities. Note: the NPE paths remain triggerable as they are application-logic bugs unaffected by kernel capabilities.

config.filesystem: readOnlyRootFilesystem with emptyDir at /tmp (noexec mount option)
